tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /g.yung ston pas gsungs pa'i phyag 'tshal bzhugs so/ /

bla ma dam pa g.yung ston pa la gu ru kun mkhyen shākya mgon pos zhus pa/ de yang dang por chos rje'i drung nas sprul sku sman lung pa la gnang*/ des rin po che myur sdings pa la gnang*/ des bla ma shākya mgon po la zhus pas dbang rdzogs lung dang bcas par zhus te/ khrid la nyan khrid du zhus pas the tshom cung ma chod nas bla ma g.yung ston pa la yongs su rdzogs par myong khrid nyams myong rang thog tu khel bar bskyangs te rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs 'phrang las thar te myong ba rdzogs par gsungs so/ /me pho khyi'i lo la gter nas byon nas lo so gsum lon pa'i tshe na zhus nas lo sgrub kyi me tog dang gser zho gang gi maṇḍal phul nas zhus/ bla ma shākya mgon po'i drung du sprang 'khyams badzra ratnas zhus te sa mo glang gi lor dgun pa ོ gro ma bstod pa dkar po chu mig rdzong kha'i dgon par dpyid zla ra ba rta pa zla ba'i tshes gsum la dbang lnga yongs su rdzogs par zhus nas nyams khrid lag khrid du rdzogs par zhus te rtags tshad kyi yi ges gtan la phab nas nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba rdzogs par bskyangs shing*/ rtsa rlung thig le la sogs pa rdzogs par lag khrid du zhus te gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ tshig dbang*/ khyad par dbang lnga rtsal dbang rnams bskyar zhing zhus te dbang rdzogs bka' rdzogs/ dpe rdzogs lung yongs su rdzogs par zhus te/ dgyes bzhin du gnang nas gzhan don gyis shig pa'i rjes gnang yang thob cing*/ sa gas nya ba'i tshes bco lnga yar bcad zla ba phyed dang bzhir gdams pa rdzogs nas dbyar ra ba'i nyin snga dro brgyud yig dang btags grol 'dogs bka' gtad pa'i dus su chos skor 'di'i bdag por gtad do/ /sprang ban rdo rje rin chen gyis ji ltar zhus pa'i tshul gyi brgyud yig bkod pa'o/ athi+-i/ ༄༅/ /e ma ho/ /rgyal ba sku gsum sar gnas rig 'dzin dang*/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung o rgyan yab yum gnyis/

/lung bstan gter ston thugs sras sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po karma pa/ /chos rje'i thugs sras mnyam med bya bral ba/ / brgyud pa'i bcud 'dus mkhyen ldan shākya mgon/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med dus nas 'khor ba'i rgyun grol du/ /las rlung shugs kyis dus mthar skyes pa yi/ / dbul rmongs glen stong blo chung ku su lu/ /bas mtha'i gnas na yid brel snyam chung ba/ /rig pa col chung rkang 'khyams sprang po bdag /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje yis/ /dam pas rjes su bzung zhing rgyud bkrol nas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthar thug nyid/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs chen snying po 'di/ /grub thob rim par brgyud nas bdag la smin/ /zab lam 'di dang mjal ba bdag skal bzang*/ /o rgyan thugs rjes ma 'ongs 'gro don du/ / mkha' 'gro snying tig zab mo gter du sbas/ /lung bstan sprul sku mkhas btsun tshul rdor gyis/ /chu mo glang la zab mo'i gter sgo phyes/ /de nas so bdun lon pa'i sa mo glang gi lo/ /lo gsar rta pa nya yi grub nyi tshes gsum la/ /spros bcas spros med khyad par dbang lnga rig pa'i rtsal dbang dang*/ / btags grol rgyud 'grel man ngag lag len bcas/ /don khrid khregs chod thod rgal ngo sprod gnang*/ /rgyab chos lung bstan man ngag gnad dang bcas/ /rtsa rlung thig le gtum mo dka' thub dang*/ /'da' kha'i lam khyer 'chi brod bar do'i gnad/ /dbang sgrub mchod gzhung las byang sgom khrid dang*/ /thun mong las mde'u kha tshar bstan srung dang*/ /yid ches lo rgyus 'phyugs med them yig bcas/ /dbang rdzogs bka' rdzogs dpe rdzogs lung rdzogs su/ /yongs rdzogs bka' gtad gnang ba de sku drin/ /snod ldan snod med kun la gnang bkag mdzod/ /bka' gtad gnyer gtad thob pa bdag skal bzang*/ /cho 'phrul rta pa'i tshes gsum nas brtsams te/

/dbyar ra sa gas nya ba'i zla rgyas par/ /dgung zla phyed dang bzhi la don chen 'grub/ /som nyi med pa'i gding rnyed de sku drin/ /rtogs pa'i ngang du goms pa'i stobs brtan nas/ /rig pa rang grol phyogs lhung med pa yi/ /mtha' bral rtsol med lhun grub gnas lugs gshis/ /snying po rnam dag mngon du 'gyur bar shog // // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)g.yung ston pas gsungs pa'i phyag 'tshal/ - PAGE 156 -- PAGE 155 -- PAGE 154 -
